messages:
claire: Tiny UX bug — paste a param snippet without "type" into the schema editor: it saves then shows a top banner "Schema failed" but no pointer to the field. Users keep opening support tickets.

jon: Can you share quick repro?

claire: Repro: new fn -> add param -> paste `{"name":"customer"}` -> save -> banner. No inline marker or focus.

riley: We currently avoid continuous validation for perf. We could do a targeted lint on the edited subtree (debounced) to catch common paste errors.

aisha: A11y note: the banner alone is announced as just "error". Need `role=alert` text that includes node path and a focusable "Jump to error" control. Suggested announcement: "Schema error in parameter 'customer': missing type. Press Enter to jump."

jon: Microcopy for inline tooltip (short):
```
Missing required field: "type".
Click or press Enter to focus this parameter.
```

riley: Dev plan: add 600ms debounce, run JSONSchema validate scoped to changed node, render an inline icon `button` with `aria-label=\"schema error: missing type\"` and keep the top banner for fatal save failures.

claire: Visual nits: the tiny red icon currently fails contrast at 12px. Recommend a darker red `#8b0000` or a 2px white halo; ensure touch target >= 44px and visible focus ring.

aisha: Keyboard flow: the "Jump to error" control should be tabbable; pressing Enter moves focus to the type input and places the cursor. Use `aria-live=\"assertive\"` only when the error appears (not on each keystroke).

jon: Related: run history shows tool-call outputs as raw JSON blobs. Proposal: show a compact preview row rendering top-level keys + types, e.g. `order: object {id: string, items: array}`, with a keyboard-focusable expand button to reveal the full tree.

riley: Server-side could return a tiny preview (first 3 keys + primitive types). Client lazy-loads full payload on expand. Use `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` for accessibility.

claire: A tiny mock of the inline marker + run-history preview before Friday would be great.

ops-bot: Tickets created: "playground/inline-schema-lint" assigned @riley, "playground/runhistory-compact-preview" assigned @jon, "playground/error-copy-tweak" assigned @aisha.

jon: I'll post quick mocks in #design-review tomorrow :thumbsup:

riley: I'll prototype the debounce + aria attributes and do an initial VoiceOver check.

aisha: Will run keyboard + VO pass once the prototype is available.
